properties.query:
SecurityRegulatoryCompliance
| where ComplianceStandard == "NIST-SP-800-171-R2"
| extend Level=iff(ComplianceControl in ("3.1.1","3.1.2","3.1.20","3.1.22","3.4.1","3.5.2","3.5.2","3.8.3","3.13.1","3.13.5","3.14.1","3.14.2","3.14.4","3.14.5"), "Level 1: Foundational","Level 2: Advanced")
| where Level == "Level 2: Advanced"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecommendationName, AssessedResourceId, Level
| extend DeviceName = extract(@"(?i)/providers/[^/]+/(?:virtualmachines|machines)/([^/]+)$", 1, tostring(AssessedResourceId))
| summarize Failed=countif(State=="Failed"),Passed=countif(State=="Passed"),Total=countif(State=="Passed" or State == "Failed"), AffectedHosts=make_set_if(DeviceName, State=="Failed" and isnotempty(DeviceName)) by Level
| extend PassedControlsPercentage = (Passed/todouble(Total))*100
| where PassedControlsPercentage < 70 
//Adjust Either Passed Thresholds within Organizational Needs
| mv-expand DeviceName = AffectedHosts
| extend DeviceName = tostring(DeviceName)
| extend RemediationLink = strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Security/SecurityMenuBlade/22')
| project Level, ComplianceStandard="CMMC 2.0", Total, PassedControlsPercentage, Passed, Failed, RemediationLink, DeviceName, LastObserved=now()
| extend URLCustomEntity = RemediationLink
properties.description: 'CMMC 2.0 Level 2 (Advanced) assessments have deviated from configured threshold baselines. This alert is triggered when CMMC2.0 policy compliance is assessed below 70% compliance in 7 days.'
properties.name: CMMC 2.0 Level 2 (Advanced) Readiness Posture
